name: prose-craft
description: Standalone prose craftsmanship for human-facing documentation — draft docs to a plain-language style contract (prose-draft), review drafts through editorial lenses (prose-review), and run a multi-model rewrite-and-weave cycle to publication quality (prose-refine). No substrate dependency.

interface.shortDescription: Draft, lens-review, and refine human-facing docs
interface.longDescription: Standalone prose craftsmanship for documentation that will be published: prose-draft pins a five-field doc brief (audience, venue, purpose, must-keeps, scope) and writes to a plain-language style contract with Diátaxis doc-type obligations; prose-review runs a single-pass review through up to six editorial lenses (four by default — audience, structure, clarity, accuracy — plus voice and accessibility) with severity-tagged findings; prose-refine drives the full multi-model cycle — parallel fresh-context re-writers of different model classes, section-by-section weaving into one voice, scope that shrinks each round (full rewrite, machine-prose tell hunting, micro-edits), and convergence to publication quality within a 3-round cap.
defaultPrompt: Use prose-craft to draft, lens-review, or refine human-facing documentation such as READMEs, foundation docs, and web articles.
